spans.s:
(स्तनति) r. 1st and 10 cls. (स्तनयति)
To sound, to thunder.

m. (-नः)
The female bosom or breast.
E.
स्तन to sound, aff. अच्.

n. (-लं)
The female breast.
E.
स्तन, and कुद्मल a bud.

n. (-नं)
1 Sound, noise in general.
2 The grumbling of clouds.
3 Breathing hard, groaning as a person in pain.
E.
स्तन to sound, aff. ल्युट्.

mf. (-यः-या or यी)
An infant, one at the breast.
E.
स्तन the breast, धेट् to drink, aff. खश्.

mf. (-पाः)
An infant at the breast.
E.
स्तन the breast, and पा who drinks.

m. (-रः)
A man with a breast like a woman's.
E.
स्तन a pap, and भर who possesses.

n. (-लं)
The female breast.
E.
स्तन, and मण्डल a globe.

m. (-खः)
A nipple.
E.
स्तन the breast, and मुख point.

m. (-त्नुः)
1 A cloud.
2 Thunder, the muttering of clouds.
3

Lightning.
4

Sickness.
5

Death.
E.
स्तन to sound, in the tenth cl. इत्नुच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-न्तः)
A nipple.
E.
स्तन the breast, and वृन्त a stalk.

f. (-खा)
A nipple.
E.
स्तन the breast, and शिखा the crest.

n. (-ग्रं)
A nipple.
E.
स्तन the breast, and अग्र point.

n. (-रं)
1 The heart, or its site, placed however immediately under the centre bone of the sternum.
2 A mark on the breast, indicative of future widowhood.
E.
स्तन the breast, and अन्तर interval.

m. (-गः)
A man with a large bosom, or one like a female's.
E.
स्तन a breast, and आभोग who enjoys.

n. (-तं)
1 The rattling of thunder, the grumbling of thunder clouds.
2 The noise of clapping the hands.
E.
स्तन to sound, aff. क्त.

n. (-न्यं)
Milk.
E.
स्तन a breast, यत् aff.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
1 Stopped, blocked, or shut up.
2 Firm, hard, stiff, rigid.
3 Stupid, dull, insensible.
4 Paralysed.
E.
स्तभि to stop, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
Having the ears erect.
E.
स्तब्ध, and कर्ण the ear.

m. (-मा)
A hog.
E.
स्तब्ध firm, and रोमन् hair of the body.

n. (-णं)
Stiffening, making rigid, paralysing.
E.
स्तब्ध, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stiffened, rigid, paralysed.
E.
स्तब्ध, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

m. (-भः)
1 A goat.
2 A ram.
E.
see स्तुभ.

m. (-म्बः)
1 A shrub, a plant that has no particular or decided stem.
2 A clump of grass, a sheaf of corn, &c.
3 The post to which an elephant is tied.
4 A mountain.
n. (-म्बं)
1 A post, a pillar in general.
2 Stupidity, insensibility.
E.
ष्ठा to stand or abide, अम्बच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रिः)
Corn or rice.
E.
स्तम्ब a cluster, and कृ to make, इन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Making or forming a heap or cluster.
E.
स्तम्ब a cluster, कृ to make, अण् aff.

m. (-नः)
1 A small hoe for weeding or eradicating clusters of gramineous plants.
2 A sickle or instrument for cutting corn.
3 A basket for holding the heads of wild rice, &c. when cut.
E.
स्तम्ब a cluster, (of stalks,) a sheaf, हन to destroy, and अप् aff.; also with कच्, aff. स्तम्बघ्न, in each case घ being substituted for ह.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Turf-destroying.
m. (-घ्नः)
A hoe or sickle, &c.: see the last; also स्तम्बघात.

f. (-पूः)
A city so named.

nf. (-नं-नी)
A hoe or sickle for eradicating weeds, cutting or reaping corn, &c.: see स्तम्बधन.
E.
स्तम्ब a cluster, a sheaf, and हनन destroying; also स्तम्बहन्, &c.

m. (-मः)
An elephant.
E.
स्तम्बे in a clump, (of high grass,) रम to sport, aff. अच्.

(उ) स्तम्भु r. 5th cl. (स्तभ्नोति) 9th cl. (स्तभ्नाति)
1 To stop, to block, to hinder.
2 To be stupid or insensible; also ष्टम्भ.

m. (-म्भः)
1 A post, a pillar, a column.
2 A stalk, a stem.
3 Stupidity, insensibility.
4 Stupefaction from fear, joy, grief, &c.
5 Coldness, (corporeally,) want of feeling or excitability, paralysis.
6 The suppression of any faculty by magical means.
7 Hindrance, obstruction.
E.
ष्टभि to stop, &c., aff. अच्.

m. (-रः)
A fence, a railing, &c.
E.
स्तम्भ opposing, and कर making.

f. (-की)
A musical instrument, covered with leather.
E.
स्तम्भक stopping, and इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Stopping, hindering, obstruction.
2 Suppression of any of the bodily faculties by magical incantations.
3 Stoppage of flow of blood, &c.
4 Any article so employed, a styptic, an astringent.
m. (-नः)
One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA.
E.
ष्टभि to stop, aff. युच् or ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stupefied, paralysed.
E.
स्तम्भ to be stupid, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Who or what spreads, extends, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 A layer, a stratum.
2 A bed.
E.
स्तृ to spread, अच् aff.

m. (-मा)
A bed, a couch.
E.
स्तृ to spread, इमनिच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-रीः)
Smoke.
E.
स्तृ to cover, Uṇādi aff. ई.

m. (-वः)
Praise, eulogium, panegyric, celebrating as a hero or hymning as a deity.
E.
ष्टु to praise, अप् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay.
2 A multitude in general.
3 Praise, eulogium.
4 A panegyrist, a praiser.
E.
ष्टु to praise, aff. वुन्, or स्था to stay, अवक Uṇādi aff., form irr.

m. (-कः)
A praiser, a panegyrist.
E.
ष्टु to praise, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
In blossom, covered with blossoms.
E.
स्तवक, and आचित heaped.

m. (-कः)
A fence, a railing, &c.

m. (-य्यः)
INDRA.
E.
ष्टु to praise, एय्य Uṇādi aff.
